title: Brief
description: Stored in dispatches.brief (stage `brief`). Deterministic SQL builds the context, one LLM call writes the text in the stakeholder's brief_lang and brief_profile, and a validator checks every cited id and every action. Keys are English; `title` and `body_markdown` are in `lang` because a person reads them. Citizen text is never copied into a brief.

body_markdown.description: Every factual sentence ends with one or more citations in square brackets, e.g. [r_1a2b3c4d] or [osm_4412].

action_id.description: Must be in domains.action_catalog of the cluster's domain.

citations.description: Index of every id used in the text, so the panel can link it.

ref.description: reports.id, geo_features.source_ref, clusters.id, or a metric key.

translations.description: The same brief in the other UI language (es <-> en), with exactly the same citations, so the panel can follow the reader's language. Missing when the translation failed: the panel shows the original.

citation_id.description: r_ = first 8 hex of a report id (unique inside one brief), c_ = cluster, osm_/naufest_ = geo_features.source_ref, m_ = computed metric (e.g. m_people_count).
